decision: Keep metadata retrieval with optional full-text ranking; semantic indexing is not justified by the current benchmark.
change_note: 2026-11-18: sparse categories now add items one formality level outside the range (INGESTION_AND_RETRIEVAL_SPEC.md section 6). Precision@5 fell from 0.845 to 0.79 (metadata) and 0.8783 to 0.8233 (full text); Recall@10 unchanged. The 2026-09-17 thesis figure (84.50%) predates this rule.
